name: Hammerhead
description: Struck, bowed and blown physical modelling: marimba, vibraphone, xylophone and glockenspiel bars, kalimba tines, bells, glass, a steel pan, and plucked or hammered strings. A mallet (hardness, strike position, impact click), a bow (stick-slip friction) or a breath (jet) drives an 8-mode resonator bank with a tuned tube, or a waveguide string; pressure and pad aftertouch, swell, vibrato, decay, damping, mute and pedal, pitch drop, motor, body and room. 16 voices, 15 programs, cheap enough for chords on the MPC.
author: Groundswell
